views.label: Front / full body
views.camera: Eye-level, straight-on, 85 mm-equivalent lens, minimal perspective distortion
views.direction: Show the complete character from head to toe in a neutral relaxed stance.

views.label: Left three-quarter
views.camera: Eye-level, left three-quarter view, 85 mm-equivalent lens
views.direction: Rotate the same character about 45 degrees; preserve face, proportions, hair, clothing, and accessories.

views.label: Left profile
views.camera: Eye-level, exact left profile, 85 mm-equivalent lens
views.direction: Show a clean side silhouette with the full body visible.

views.label: Back / full body
views.camera: Eye-level, straight rear view, 85 mm-equivalent lens
views.direction: Show the complete rear construction of hair, clothing, and accessories.

views.label: Neutral portrait
views.direction: Use a neutral expression and reveal identity-defining facial details clearly.

views.label: Warm expression
views.direction: Use a subtle genuine smile without changing facial structure, styling, or age.

views.label: Front
views.camera: Straight-on front product view, long lens, minimal perspective distortion
views.direction: Show the complete object centered and unobstructed.

views.label: Left three-quarter
views.camera: Elevated left three-quarter product view, long lens
views.direction: Reveal front, side, and depth while preserving exact construction.

views.label: Left side
views.direction: Show the full side silhouette and all visible fittings.

views.label: Back
views.camera: Straight-on rear product view, long lens
views.direction: Show the complete rear construction and markings.

views.label: Top
views.direction: Show the complete top plane and footprint.

views.label: Construction detail
views.direction: Show the most identity-defining material junction, mechanism, label, or wear pattern.

views.label: Establishing
views.direction: Establish the full location and spatial relationships around the exact source scene.

views.label: Wide
views.direction: Show the full subject and enough environment to preserve blocking.

views.label: Full
views.direction: Frame the complete principal subject from head to toe or show the complete object.

views.label: Medium
views.direction: Frame the principal subject at medium distance while preserving eyelines and screen direction.

views.label: Medium close-up
views.direction: Prioritize the principal subject from chest up without altering identity or performance.

views.label: Close-up
views.direction: Frame the principal face or story-critical detail closely while preserving exact continuity.

views.label: Over shoulder
views.direction: Create a motivated over-the-shoulder composition; preserve geography, eyelines, and character sides.

views.label: High angle
views.camera: 35 mm lens, camera above the subject looking down
views.direction: Change only camera elevation and framing; preserve the scene layout.

views.label: Low angle
views.camera: 35 mm lens, camera below the subject looking up
views.direction: Change only camera elevation and framing; preserve the scene layout.
